title: Kan simplicial models for arrows over the infinity category of spaces
statement: Use simplicial sets, ordinary nerves, quasicategories, coherent functor categories, mapping spaces and equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the infinity category of small spaces $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Fix nested universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'\in\mathcal U''$ large enough for the following categories. Let $\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathcal U}$ be the ordinary category of $\mathcal U$-small simplicial sets and let $j:N(\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathcal U})\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ be passage to the homotopy type, exhibiting spaces as its homotopy coherent localization at weak homotopy equivalences. Let $p:\mathcal E\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ be any coherent functor from an infinity category fitting in $\mathcal U'$, and form the infinity-categorical pullback $\mathcal P=N(\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathcal U})\times^h_{\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}}\mathcal E$, with projection $r:\mathcal P\to\mathcal E$. An object of this pullback is a triple $(K,A,\alpha)$ with an equivalence $\alpha:jK\simeq pA$. For every arrow $F:A\to B$ of $\mathcal E$, there are $\mathcal U$-small Kan complexes $K,L$, equivalences $\alpha:jK\simeq pA$, $\beta:jL\simeq pB$, an actual simplicial map $f:K\to L$, and an arrow $\widetilde F:(K,A,\alpha)\to(L,B,\beta)$ in $\mathcal P$ projecting to $f$ in $N(\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathcal U})$ and to the component of $F$ in $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E}(A,B)$. In particular, $\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,r)$ is essentially surjective: every arrow of $\mathcal E$ is equivalent in its coherent arrow category to an image arrow. A Kan complex is allowed to be empty. No Cartesian-fibration hypothesis on $p$ is imposed.
